semantic_discovery.purpose: structure and BOS semantic discovery, fixed hash sampling and causal tests only; no profitability or threshold selection

belief_calibration.purpose: one fixed monotone reliability calibration after semantic gates pass; no threshold search

action_clock_development.purpose: single registered action-value development run after a v3 belief artifact is frozen

rolling_validation.purpose: one expanding-window temporal OOF evaluation for each frozen protocol, code and data hash

sealed_holdout.purpose: single final structural reveal only after all semantic and pre-holdout economic gates pass

revealed_execution_development.purpose: June execution fit and July temporal validation only after OHLCV gates pass

sealed_holdout.purpose: single final MBO reveal after every prior structural, action and execution gate passes

leakage_rules: Every structure primitive is observed only after its registered same-timeframe completed-bar confirmation clock.
No future bar, PnL, MFE, MAE, action label or realized best entry may affect swing, structure or BOS semantics.
A lower-timeframe close cannot confirm a higher-timeframe BOS.
Unknown data gaps and contract changes reset structure and pending BOS state.
Fixed semantic cases are selected only by the preregistered protocol-hash and event-id hash.
Every action freezes its plan before any future path is read.
Shadow outcomes may label actions but may never alter the reader, belief, candidate population or current-clock features.
Belief calibration fitted on 2022 may be used only from 2023 onward.
All folds train strictly before their validation interval and a frozen hash receives one OOF evaluation.
MBO absence remains explicit; constants cannot impersonate execution reality.
AI review may emit registered sequence primitives only and has no action or profit-label authority.
Any result-driven change creates a later experiment and the revealed interval remains development evidence.
